name: Classic Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the spaghetti according to package instructions.
While the pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add finely diced onion and minced garlic. SautÃ© until translucent and fragrant (about 3-4 minutes).
Add the ground beef. Cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned.
Pour in the tomato sauce, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Drain the pasta and toss it with the Bolognese sauce. Serve immediately, generously topped with freshly grated parmesan cheese.

name: Quick Avocado Toast with Egg
instructions: Toast the slices of bread to your desired level of crispiness.
In a small bowl, mash the avocado with a fork. Mix in a splash of lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Cook the egg to your preference (fried, poached, or scrambled) in a small non-stick pan.
Spread the mashed avocado evenly over the toasted bread.
Top with the cooked egg and sprinkle with a pinch of red pepper flakes for some heat.

name: Chicken and Broccoli Stir Fry
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, minced garlic, grated ginger, sesame oil, and cornstarch. This is your stir-fry sauce.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until no longer pink.
Add the broccoli florets to the pan and stir-fry for another 3-5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and broccoli. Toss constantly for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats everything.
Serve hot over steamed rice.

name: Fresh Caprese Salad
instructions: Slice the tomatoes and the fresh mozzarella cheese into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
Arrange the tomato and mozzarella slices on a serving platter, alternating them and slightly overlapping.
Tuck fresh basil leaves between the slices.
Drizzle generously with high-quality extra virgin olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with a pinch of flaky sea salt and freshly ground black pepper just before serving.

name: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk the buttermilk, egg, and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients. Stir gently until just combined (don't overmix; lumps are okay).
Heat a lightly oiled griddle or frying pan over medium heat.
Scoop the batter onto the griddle, using approximately 1/4 cup for each pancake. Cook until bubbles form on the surface, then flip and cook until lightly browned on the other side.
Serve hot with butter and maple syrup.

name: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup
instructions: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add chopped onions and sautÃ© until soft and translucent.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 more minute until fragrant.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream and fresh basil leaves. Simmer for another 5 minutes.
Use an immersion blender (or transfer to a regular blender in batches) to puree the soup until smooth.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve warm, ideally with grilled cheese.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
instructions: Rinse and dry the shrimp using paper towels. Season with salt and pepper.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the shrimp and cook for 1 minute per side until pink.
Reduce heat to medium. Add the butter and minced garlic to the skillet.
Cook for another minute, basting the shrimp with the garlic butter.
Remove from heat, squeeze fresh lemon juice over the top, and garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve immediately, perhaps with some crusty bread to soak up the sauce.

name: Vegetarian Chili
instructions: Heat a splash of oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add diced onion, bell pepper, and garlic. SautÃ© until tender.
Stir in chili powder and cumin, cooking for 1 minute to toast the spices.
Add the drained kidney beans, black beans, diced tomatoes (with juices), and vegetable broth.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce heat to low, cover, and let it cook for at least 30 minutes to let flavors meld.
Serve hot, garnished with your favorite toppings like cheese, sour cream, or cilantro.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
instructions: Peel the banana and slice it directly into your blender.
Add the peanut butter, milk, a drizzle of honey, and a dash of cinnamon.
Add a handful of ice cubes.
Blend on high speed until completely smooth and creamy.
Pour into a tall glass and enjoy immediately.

name: Bacon and Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Chop the bacon into small pieces and fry in a large skillet or wok over medium heat until crispy.
Remove most of the bacon fat, leaving about 1 tablespoon in the pan. SautÃ© the frozen peas and carrots until thawed and tender.
Push the vegetables to one side of the pan. Crack the eggs into the other side and scramble them until fully cooked.
Add the cold, pre-cooked day-old rice to the pan along with the crispy bacon.
Drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil. Stir-fry everything together for 3-5 minutes until heated through.
Garnish with chopped green onions before serving.
